in_arabic.name: عابدات
in_arabic.long_meaning: عابدات هي اسم مؤنث جمع عابدة، وتعني في اللغة العربية العابدات، المؤمنات، الصالحات. وهي مشتقة من الفعل عَبَدَ، الذي يعني في القرآن الكريم الخضوع لله وحده. العابدات هن النساء اللاتي يخضعن لله وحده، ويؤمنن به، ويعبدنه بصدق واخلاص. وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحج آية 26: 'وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَجَعْلْنَا فِي الذُّرِّيَّةِ النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ بَعضُهُم مُّؤْمِنٌ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ'

The name Aabidat has its roots in the Arabic language and is mentioned in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes a person's commitment to their faith and their actions in accordance with Islamic values. The name Aabidat carries a sense of spirituality, devotion, and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Aabidat" is derived from the Arabic root word "a'buda" which means "to worship" or "to serve". Historically, the Muslim community has placed great importance on acts of worship as fundamental aspects of their faith and way of life. The name Aabidat reflects this cultural emphasis on devotion, piety, and servitude to Allah. This could be seen as an expression of the cornerstone tenet of Islam, which calls for the submission to the will of Allah (Islam means "submission").
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Aabidat" lies in its recognition of the servant's role in the divine-human relationship. Muslims view themselves not as independent creatures, but as creatures who exist to serve and worship Allah. The name Aabidat encourages individuals to constantly remain mindful of their duty to their Creator, to strive for excellence in their duties, and to seek forgiveness for their mistakes. Ultimately, the spiritual significance of the name Aabidat underscores the Muslim's fundamental belief in the dependency on Allah's mercy and grace to attain salvation and eternal bliss.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Servant" symbolizes The one who worships and serves Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aabidat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of servant.
